To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
rare earth metal coordination catalysts are effective catalysts to polymerize propylene sulfide and produce high molecular weight polymer.

rare earth catalysts composed of rare earth compound of phosphonate or naphthenate, trialkyll sluminum and water can catalyze the polymerization of monomers such as propylene oxide and ethylene oxide to give high molecular weight polymers with high yield.

the ring-opening polymerization of propylenesulfide can be carried out with high molecular weight polymers with high yields and high molecular weight distribution using a rare earth catalyst system composed of rare earth phosphonate, trialkysluminum and water.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and application of rare earth coordination catalyst systems for the ring-opening polymerization of propyIene sulfide, and with the structure of the resulting poly(propylene sulfides).
the synthesis of novel poly(propylene sulfides) and the study of their properties.
the development of rare earth coordination catalyst for the ring opening polymerization of cyclic sulfides.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the polymerization of the cyclic monomers, such as propylene sulfide by the rare earth coordination catalyst system is a homogeneous process.
the rare earth coordination catalyst is a very effective and efficient catalyst for the polymerization.
the polymerization of the monomer is a living polymerization and the polymer is a high molecular weight linear polymer with high crystallinity and high glass transition temperature.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a new type of catalyst for the ring opening polymerization of cyclic sulfides has been found, and a novel method to prepare poly(propylene sulfides) with high molecular weight and high yield has been established.
the polymerization is a coordination polymerization and the polymerization mechanism is similar to that of the polymerization of ethylene by the same catalysts.
the polymerization reaction proceeds via coordination insertion mechanism and the polymerization reaction rate is controlled by the rate of the insertion of the monomer into the metal-olefin bond.
The main takeaway from our work is that
rare earth coordination catalyst is a promising catalyst system for polymerization of propylenesulfide.
the polymerization of cyclic sulfides can be carried out by rare earth coordination catalyst.
rare earth coordination catalyst is a novel catalyst for the polymerization reaction of propylene sulfides.
